purpose: Portable bounded acceptance ledger; summary evidence, not raw diagnostics or a complete conformance claim.
guideline_policy: Existing GS registry URLs and access dates retained; no new external source visit claimed.
review_scope: Expert screenshot/source review, targeted tests, final integrated Chromium tasks and selected rendered-content review; not human usability research.

records.summary: Long opaque reference IDs obscured unavailable state in selection controls.
records.required_invariants: Readable state, accessible complete stable identity, distinct checking states, exact repair occurrence, no automatic replacement.

candidate_regression.affected_version: Initial candidate disabling default Select virtualization, not the original product baseline
candidate_regression.summary: A 2,000-node data set rendered 2,003 options on opening. Default virtualization was restored while preserving readable complete long identities.

additional_findings.summary: Paused reads with cached data must not imply confirmed missing references.
additional_findings.limitation: Does not establish that a complete offline application displays the workspace.

additional_findings.summary: Mobile reference disclosure retains a visible native expansion marker and a 44 px project target.
additional_findings.limitation: The 44 px target is a project choice, not a universal WCAG AA rule.

records.summary: Initial source-file dialog screenshot omitted completion actions; other disclosure screenshots were taken after scripted scrolling. This does not prove the task was impossible.
records.required_invariants: Disclosure and completion stay together; required inputs, errors and focus remain reachable; local file reading precedes upload on submit.
privacy_facts: Not automatically added to shared server routes

candidate_regression.affected_version: Completion-area relocation and shared-record instance candidates, not the original product baseline
candidate_regression.summary: Native submit association was first restored; simultaneous instances of the same business record then exposed label/submit ownership collisions. Instance-unique React useId associates each form, label and submit while preserving record identity and payload fields.

records.summary: New subscription repeated mode restrictions while the required checking action had an ambiguous name; comprehension impact is an expert judgment.
records.required_invariants: Checking does not create or publish; changed inputs invalidate the check; new independent link and unchanged sibling subscriptions are disclosed; a new explicit action authorizes publishing.

candidate_regression.affected_version: Initial in-place check-to-publish candidate, not the original product baseline
candidate_regression.summary: Double-click continuation or held Enter could publish without fresh intent after the primary action changed.
candidate_regression.correction_scope: Distinct button identity, rejection of continuation clicks and current-review focus; targeted double-click and held-Enter cases changed from failure to pass without artificial delay. Final browser acceptance also verified a native continuation at the same screen coordinate does not publish, while later fresh intent publishes exactly once.

records.summary: Zero-source collection editor still described merging and retaining nodes; observation was in a confirmation screenshot background, not the collection list empty state.
records.required_invariants: Truthful zero-source text; processing can be prepared before source selection; order, per-source steps, post-merge steps, preview and save remain available.

additional_findings.summary: Collection save hitbox measured 88x38 px before the narrow correction and 88x44 px after at 320/390 widths.
additional_findings.limitation: Project touch target, not a universal WCAG AA rule.

additional_findings.summary: Public StepsEditor default empty text was made neutral after the isolated browser run. Existing production callers already explicitly supply text or null.
additional_findings.limitation: A later 32-test DOM and typecheck pass does not mean the earlier 8 browser cases were rerun.

final_verification.source_manifest_scope: 583 source/config/test files for full Web and static verification; not all workspace/document files

runs.summary: Independent full rerun after fixture corrections; source disclosure, reference identity, distinct publication intent and collection controls verified on the integrated tree.
runs.scope: Local synthetic Chromium 153 sandbox tasks, not deployment or all-device evidence.
runs.coverage_limit: Final zero-selection collection task had available inventory. No-available-sources was a separate cold diagnostic, not an additional member of this 41 count.

runs.limitation: Tracked-private guard remains blocked by absent Git metadata; not an aggregate all-gates pass.
Unchanged inputs justify reuse, not a new Go execution. Managed-runtime offline dependencies, skipped native paths and VCS stamping remain unverified.
Synthetic read-only preview does not prove real authentication, backend writes, publication or applied network behavior.

reviewed_views: Initial source disclosure/completion at 1280, 390 and 320 px
Missing reference status and exact occurrence details at desktop and narrow widths
Full configuration natural-result focus at 1280, 390 and 320 px
visual_review.summary: Required object/client/mode/consequence context remains visible, optional technical content remains scrollable, and no repetitive footer explanation is needed.
visual_review.limitation: Selected synthetic business states only, not human comprehension research or all-state accessibility certification.

limitations: Different targeted runs, historical failed runs and the final 41-task run are not summed into a synthetic pass rate.
Full Web, final browser and offline preview are bounded passing evidence, not an aggregate all-gates pass or complete product acceptance.
Absent Git metadata blocks the tracked-private guard and unmodified aggregate gate.
Managed-runtime offline dependency gaps and 50 native/opt-in skip events remain outside passing evidence; no deployment or applied traffic is established.
Previous eight formatting warnings are resolved; existing large-chunk and non-failing component deprecation advisories remain maintenance items.
Official guidance and project synthesis are distinct; no Google certification, complete WCAG conformance or human-comprehension outcome is claimed.
Two later collection continuity/discoverability findings remain open outside CH-01–04 acceptance.

bounded_verification.summary: Reference state and identity contracts, including virtualization and paused-read behavior.
bounded_verification.limitation: Not a complete application offline or integrated browser claim.

bounded_verification.summary: Readable states and complete identity access in the bounded reference-repair task.
Native per-instance form association, zero/one/multiple sources, ordering, processing layers and preserved input contracts.
Initial disclosure/completion pairing, files and options, short viewport and doubled text, zero/one/multiple collections, preview and save.
bounded_verification.synthetic_failure: One explicitly synthetic POST 503 supplied the long-error layout state; not an observed real service outage.
bounded_verification.version_limit: Precedes the later shared Pipeline default-text cleanup.

bounded_verification.summary: Public neutral StepsEditor empty state and workspace regressions.
bounded_verification.limitation: Later cleanup was not a rerun of CH-EV-04.

bounded_verification.summary: Check/publish stages, exact review identity, separate explicit intent and recovery contracts.
bounded_verification.limitation: Eight new contract cases failing against baseline are not eight independent pre-existing defects.

bounded_verification.summary: Object, client, mode and independent-link consequence remain visible in the reviewed states; no additional repetitive footer copy added.
bounded_verification.limitation: Not all viewports/states or human-comprehension evidence.

failure_classification: Test selector matched a hidden dropdown
bounded_verification.summary: The original 39/41 run remains failed. Test assumptions were corrected without changing production; a later independent invocation freshly reran all 41. Counts are not concatenated.

remaining_findings.summary: Collection editor lacks in-task source add/import. Saving or explicitly discarding, visiting sources and reopening remains possible; this is a continuity gap, not a dead end.
remaining_findings.next_scope: Preserve the same collection draft and explicit save boundary while adding a source in context.
remaining_findings.limitation: The reviewed empty editor screenshot shows zero selected sources, not a proven zero-inventory account; the no-available-source branch is source-confirmed.

remaining_findings.summary: Collapsed source rows show name/order but hide source-processing purpose and configured-step state until expanded.
remaining_findings.next_scope: Make purpose and configured-step state discoverable while preserving source identity, order, keyboard behavior and both processing layers.

next_round_scope: Only NEXT-01 and NEXT-02; no global terminology sweep. Findings are expert review, not human user-study results.
